unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u10.detail: Not closed. Verified (league release wording relayed by web search): four teams of three with two current players and one legend, seven spots in fixed order, 70 s, two rounds, higher final-round score wins. Per-spot values (reported 2,2,2,3,2,3,4) were seen only as search-tool readings of the league rules PDF with spots 1-3 and 7 quoted, the advancement tie (30 s shoot-off) rests on secondary outlets and the final-round tie rule is reported inconsistently; attempts per spot are unknown. nba.shooting_stars_team_skill now carries these as explicit UNVERIFIED parameters (U1-U5) and is forbidden to simulate; evidence in evidence_zblk/NBA_u10_shooting_stars.json.
